baseCatalog: M5 Supplemental Competition Content v1.1 (original bytes unchanged)
policy: Canonical locations and venue names replace proposed prestige presentation names in the M6 compiler. Native geometry, surfaces, prices and field-strength bindings remain unchanged. Descriptive venue names such as Hearthvale Oval identify an explicitly stated canonical location and racing association; they do not establish new city lore or new circuit geometry.
specialQualification: Sundaran uses the existing Iron Gauntlet economic context, requiring all seven ordinary national Prestige victories. Bannerfall is never fabricated or awarded for this purpose.
geometryInterpretation: An authored native circuit is a technical layout used at the named host venue, not a claim that the canonical source supplied exact coordinates. The two Karthen circuit presets are configurations of the canonical Redstone Circuit.
distanceClassification: Short Oval and native C01 require at least 3 laps. Other closed-loop presets require at least 2. Circuits are provisionally classified by measured native center-line length: short <=1000 world units, medium <=1600, long >1600. Rally remains point-to-point. No geometry or numerical simulation changes.
